batting.name: ML Hayden
batting.dismissal: c MK Pandey b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c R Vinay Kumar b RE van der Merwe

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c MV Boucher b P Kumar

batting.name: JDP Oram
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b MS Gony

balls.text: a boundary wrecks the over, Morkel makes room and cracks a full toss from round the wicket, the ball heads to deep extra cover and lands on the half volley just in front of the boundary rope, it looked like it landed flat on the rope (which would have been a six) but 'eagle-eyes' Koertzen watched it properly
gets a friendly full toss but he mistimes it to long-on
fired outside off and he drives hard to deep cover, what an over this is
another excellent yorker, fires it outside off and Morkel can't jam it out

just pitches it up a bit outside off and Oram reaches out and tries to scoop it over third man but the ball lands in Uthappa's palms just in front of the rope, Uthappa makes a gesture to the crowd with his arms stretched
fast yorker wide outside off and the batsman leaves it thinking it will be called a wide
excellent yorker to finish the over, he digs it out back to the bowler
half volley outside off but Praveen gets away with it as Oram drives hard to deep cover again
kneels down and crashes a full delivery straight to deep cover
full outside off and jammed to long-off
he was due for a big one! He stays at the crease, clears his front leg and slams him over long-on, you cannot overpitch at this stage
fires a yorker outside off and he squeezes it out to third man
clips it with the turn to midwicket
turns, clips his pads and rolls to the off side
waits for it and dabs it late to short third man
fires it quick down the leg side and he doesn't offer a shot
well-judged catch by Vinay! Dhoni charges down the pitch on seeing the flight and nearly succeeds in going downtown but Vinay watches it closely at long-on, falls backwards just inches from the rope
gets a lot of turn and Morkel clubs it down to long-on
waits for it and dabs it down to short third man
he drops it short and forces Dhoni to check his shot after charging down the pitch, he punches it past short cover
makes room and slaps him down to sweeper cover
the wrong 'un beats him
Albertus goes maximum! Kumble gives it a lot of air and cuts back on the pace, Morkel clears his front leg and deposits it high over wide long-on
stays back and slaps it down to cover
pushes it through the line and takes a single to long-on
clips it with the turn wide of midwicket
flighted on middle and off and he steers it down to deep point
flighted on middle and leg, he pushes it to long-on
gets forward and pushes it just wide of cover
makes room, waits for the turn and slaps it to deep mid-off, Kohli fires a quick throw
drops it really short and the ball stops on Dhoni as he swivels and pulls, the ball clips his arm and rolls to the off side
another slower ball and he gets an inside edge to the on side
comes round the wicket, Morkel punches it down to Kumble at cover
comes down the pitch and Dhoni forces a full delivery down to long-off
makes room and taps him wide of cover

and another bowling change works! Praveen Kumar very cleverly bowls the slow leg cutter and Raina, who chips down the pitch, miscues the loft and the ball is chipped in the air, Boucher snaps it easily
gives it a lot of air on the legstump and Rains scoops it over midwicket, Taylor picks it up
lunges forward and pushes a full delivery to cover
comes down the pitch and he works it to long-off
full on middle and off, he pushes it to long-on
gets across and paddles it down to fine leg, Manish Pandey fumbles and Kumble is peeved
tucks it to deep midwicket and puts a lot of pressure on the fielder by calling for the second run
gets beside the line and thumps it hard to long-off
the short ball comes on real quick and the ball strikes his elbow as he shapes to pull
gets beside the line and steers it to backward point
hits the deck hard and Raina withdraws from the upper cut
out of there! He drops it short and Raina stays at the wicket and plays a humongous pull over wide long-on, all the spectators had to crank their necks, the ball is lost
Raina bends his left knee for his trademark loft, he gets a lot of elevation and the placement is just right as the ball drops wide of Praveen Kumar at deep extra cover
comes down the pitch and drives inside out to gully, Uthappa is the fielder
stays back and crashes it hard to sweeper cover
chips down and checks his shot, the ball clips his pads and rolls away
waits for the ball to come onto him and thumps it hard to wide long-off, Kohli mops up
sweeps but the ball clips his pads and rolls to the on side
makes room and cuts a straighter delivery to deep cover
gets behind the line and thumps it hard down the pitch but can't beat Kallis
gets beside the line and taps him hard to Taylor at deep cover
strays down the legside and Raina opts out of the shot again
teases him with a short ball that fizzes over the stumps, he sways backwards but offers no shot
gets beside the line and taps it hard to Kohli at backward point
swivels to pull but he ends up gloving it to the on side
stays back and punches him hard straight to mid-off
squirts it hard back to the bowler and he slides and intercepts it
clips it against the turn to wide mid-on
kneels down and mows him to deep square-leg
knocks it down to midwicket and picks up a single
dabs it to gully and Raina charges out of his crease and scampers back, careful Sir
flighted on middle and off, he clips it to short square-leg
angles it on the body and he shuffles and works it to short fine-leg
pushes it to the on side

the bowling change works! Pitches probably an inch or two outside leg (at least according to the tramline), drifts away and catches him on the pad in front of the offstump, Taufel is happy with the appeal
cramped for room and he goes for the cut but he swishes at thin air
gets beside the line and taps it down to cover
Superman van der Merwe flings himself to his right and makes a brilliant save at wide mid-off, that was heading to the rope
angles it on middle and leg, he works it past square-leg
stays back and punches it back to the bowler
quick through the air and Parthiv digs it out to long-on
pushes it towards mid-on and an enthusiastic van der Merwe runs after it
pushes it with the turn to long-on
strays on the pads and Dhoni clips it down to fine leg, Kumble gives the chase, look at him run!

Bangalore have got the valuable breakthrough! Hayden tries to mow him across the line again but Vinay takes the pace off the ball, he doesn't get the desired elevation and Pandey takes it comfortably at deep midwicket
the slower ball costs Vinay a massive six, Hayden picks the offcutter and smotes it across the line and over deep midwicket
swings across the line and mistimes it a bit to deep midwicket
gets forward and pushes it through the line to long-on
dabs it softly to backward point but Hayden wisely sends him back on seeing the lightning Kohli charge towards the ball
tries to work it to the on side but the ball clips his body and rolls to the off side
shuffles on the backfoot and clips it to deep square-leg
pushes it hard down to long-on
attempts a reverse sweep and he's caught on the pads but outside the line of leg, stifled appeal
flashy and very risky! He makes room and slaps a slower delivery dropped short, Kallis gives it his all at short cover to pull off a one-handed blinder
and Kumble nearly snares him first ball, Hayden chips one back to the bowler but the ball dips and bounces
this man's upstaging Hayden tonight! Vinay comes round the wicket but drops it a fraction too short for this surface, Parthiv gets on top of the bounce and mows him over wide midwicket
that's a gift, half volley on the offstump asking to be hit and Parthiv has a free swing of the bat and carts it over mid-off
goes for a flashy upper  cut  off a short ball but he fails to make contact
the keeper is upto the stumps, Hayden plays a short arm pull to deep square-leg
hangs his bat out and deftly glides it to third man
he gets away with one as he strays on the body and the batsman works it straight to Kallis at short fine leg
miscues a pull over square leg but the ball drops short and safe

close! He pushes it just wide of mid-off and van der Merwe slides and cuts it off, they take a chance with the second run and the throw is just wide of the stumps, Kallis was a little lazy in getting to the stumps, otherwise Parthiv would have been in deep trouble
wasted appeal, the ball pitches outside and clips his pads
angles it on the body and he clips it down to deep square-leg
comes down the pitch and goes for an almighty heave and misses
strays on the pads and he times it well past midwicket, Kumble gives it everything as he sprints and tries to pull it back but the ball accelerates as it reaches the rope
crack! Praveen overpitches outside off and Parthiv gets all his power behind that shot and crashes it past cover and mid-off
Hayden's the spectator again as he watches Parthiv get on top of the bounce and club Praveen over midwicket,  nice shot
excellent change of pace, embarrassing moment for Parthiv as he heaves and misses
takes a couple of paces down and pushes a low full toss to mid-on and still takes a chance with the single, nervy moment there
angles it inwards towards the offstump from round the wicket and hes clipped away to van der Merwe at deep midwicket
low inswinging full toss and he clips it to deep square-leg, there's protection there
this time Parthiv connects and how! Kallis hits the deck hard and Parthiv follows the bounce a lot better this time and gets enough wood on the upper cut to get the ball sailing over the slips
good comeback by kallis as he bangs it in shorter and nearly gets Parthiv to edge the upper cut
crack! Kallis errs by dropping it short and giving it width, Parthiv rolls his wrists and gives it a mightly thump past backward point and cover point, lovely precision and placement
skids through off a good length and he taps it back to the bowler
drops it short and the ball doesn't rise too much but Parthiv is quick to the task and connects well with the pull, there's enough power to beat square leg
that's a really firm punch past bowler and mid-on gets across and cuts it off
nice over to begun with, he opens the face and steers it straight to gully
forces it straight to mid-on and tells Hayden to wait
flays at it hard outside the offstump and the ball keeps a bit low and creeps underneath the bat
closes the face and mistimes the straight drive, Praveen nearly deflects the ball back at the stumps
swings it on the pads and he helps it on its way to Kallis at fine leg
moves it away from parthiv and he softly steers it wide of Taylor at gully, he slides and cuts it off

game over and Bangalore make it to the final! It's a half volley on the pads and he whips it past midwicket, several red shirts make their way to the outfield, we have a fairytale climax in the final, the two bottom-placed teams from last year will fight it out this time for the trophy
excellent yorker and he manages to dig it out
short delivery and he pulls to deep square-leg
squeezes out a yorker outside off to Balaji at third man
fired on the pads and he clips it to short fine leg, they scamper through for the run
it's a waist high full toss and Taylor moves across and clubs it over deep squre leg, Koertzen signals a four at first and the decision goes upstairs, it's a six and a no-ball as well
pushes it back to the bowler, now they've seen off Murali

even Murali isn't spared! As Ian Chappell often says, if you want to chip down the track you might as well go the full distance and that's what Kohli does, gets right to the pitch of the ball and slams him several rows back over the sight screen
chips down the track and checks his shot
quick and flat on the pads and he clips it behind square
gets forward and drives to the covers
flat and wide outside off, he makes room and cuts to Gony at deep cover
comes down the pitch and forces it to long-on
Raina to the party! Raina bowls it flat and Kohli gives the charge and takes him downtown over wide long-on, Vijay Mallya and co loved that
fires it flat and quick again and the ball clips his pads and rolls away
welcome boundary! Raina fires it flat and on a length, he thumps him across the line and has enough elevation to clear deep midwicket
chips it in the air towards cover
chips down and Raina bangs it in short, he thumps it to Dhoni at mid-off and the non-striker scampers back to beat the throw
that's a nasty skidder which beats his hopeful prod outside the offstump, phew that was close
lunges forward and defends with a dead bat
hits his pads outside the line of leg, stifled appeal
clips it to the on side and there's hesitation in the running, Kohli goes back
bowled flat and quick and Taylor gets off the mark immediately with a firm flick to deep mid-on

Is there a twist here? Murali lands it on middle and leg from round the wicket and the ball straightens, Dravid shapes to sweep but he's caught on the base of the pad, Taufel raises the finger, Hawkeye shows it hitting the middle stump
flashes hard at a slower delivery outside off and misses
shapes to drive square but he gets an inside edge to the on side
mows it down the ground to deep midwicket and Morkel runs across to cut it off
gets across and clips a low full toss down to deep midwicket
Balaji errs by pitching it up wide outside off, Dravid gets on his knee and scoops him over extra cover, right in the gap
makes room and softly steers it to the off side
pushed back to the bowler
clips it to deep square-leg and that's the 100
goes down and paddles it to short fine leg
works it just past the bowler and raina nearly takes Dravid with him as he dives to stop the ball
goes on the backfoot and slams it to long-on
the straighter one foxes him as he shapes to cut, nearly an edge to the keeper
he shifts to the backfoot and pulls him hard to long-on
clips him to deep midwicket
gets forward and steers him down to point
the arm ball foxes him! Very slow through the air and Pandey goes for the slog way too early and loses his leg stump which lands a yard back
gets forward and pushes it to the off side
shapes to slog but checks his shot and flicks him to deep midwicket
stays back and pushes it back to the bowler
stays back and clips it straight to short midwicket
straightens after pitching and he makes room to cut him to sweeper cover
another quiet flick to fine leg and Badri picks it up
flicks him with the turn to fine leg
the ball strikes the base of the pad as he tries to sweep and Murali appeals, that was hitting outside the line of the offstump
reaches out and slaps him hard down to point
class from Dravid again, he moves a long way across his stumps and improvises with an imposing flick to beat the diving Hayden at midwicket, the ball just scorched through
gives him width and he reaches out and dabs it down to third man
bowls the yorker and he squeezes it out to long-on
gets beside the line and taps it to cover, nice line
starts off with a slower ball and he reaches out to cut but misses
gets on his knee and sweeps him down to short midwicket
reaches out and drives towards cover
this one is bowled flat and skids through, Dravid rocks back and slaps it past short cover
Appeal! gets well forward and defends and the ball clips his pad again, may have missed leg
bowls a restrictive line, Dravid defends forward
comes round the wicket, hits his pads just outside the line of leg as he defends, Murali appeals
Dravid punches it with as much power as the previous boundary but his placement is spot on, he rocks back and slaps it past cover, the sweeper had no chance
slow through the air and he defends to the off side again
well bowled, cuts back on the pace and he checks his drive
another delightful sound! He makes room, gives himself enough space to thump him crisply past cover, Badri pulls it back, dives, but the ball spins back to the rope
makes room and thumps it off the meat of the bat, beats Raina at short cover
sweeps square on the on side and finds Oram at deep midwicket
tries to work it past midwicket but he can't get past the fielder
makes a bit of room and forces it to long-off
tucks it to midwicket
gets to the pitch of the ball and drives to long-off
tries to unsettle him by slogging it but he keeps it along the ground, Murali's throw is weak and they complete the second
gets forward to the pitch of the ball and drives to cover
makes room and takes a single to long-off
inside out drive back to the bowler, nearly a leading edge
Jakati slides to his left and cuts off a drive
flighted outside off and he works it through the line to long-off
clears his front leg and clips it to the on side
pushes it hard but finds mid-off
pushes it towards the on side
Dravid's a class act! The ball angles towards the pads and Dravid plays a superb flick past midwicket, he made sure he got his body right behind the ball at the point of contact
pushes it to cover and takes a chance with Dhoni's arm, Dravid was quick enough
well disguised slower ball and he has Pandey slashing and missing outside off
drops it too short and Pandey who was already on the front foot swats it over midwicket, he managed to make that shot look good in the end
flighted on middle and leg, he clips it to short midwicket
gets forward and drives hard between long-off and cover
he flights it on middle and off and he gets on his knee and slogs him over midwicket, a bit more power and that would have carried over the rope
well bowled, cuts back on the pace and flight and Dravid checks his drive back to the bowler
clips it straight to midwicket
what a shot! Jakati overpitches on middle and leg and Dravid plays a thundering straight drive past the bowler and mid-on, nobody moved
taps it to backward point and steals a single, Badri makes a sound effort by sliding and underarming the ball towards the stumps, he would have made it home had it been a direct hit
Free Hit Drops it short and takes the pace off the ball, Dravid mistimes the pull to midwicket, pandey sends him and a direct hit would have sent Dravid back
hits the deck hard but unfortunately drags his front foot past the crease, Pandey hops and fends it to the on side
he isn't done yet! Gony pitches it up outside off and he swings him across the line and clears mid-on
class again! He gets across to get behind the line and he offers the full face and drives on the run, the ball just speeds away past the narrow window between mid-off and cover
gets behind and taps it towards cover

silken! He adjusts on the backfoot, waits for the ball to come onto him, opens the face of the bat and times the backfoot punch so crisply past backward point, third man was square but the timing was just too good
angles it on the pads and he clips it to square leg

what a comeback and the legstump goes for a spin! van der Merwe exposes his stumps and Morkel fires a yorker on the stumps, the batsman fails to squeeze it out and watches the stump disappear, and Murali is the most relieved of the lot
Dropped And it's Murali! van der Merwe mis-hits, he shapes to clobber him over midwicket but the ball lobs up towards mid-off, Murali pedals backwards, catches it at first and then fumbles
gets behind the line and defends firmly
excellent running, he tucks it in front of mid-on and calls quickly
drives inside out to mid-off and Murali off all people fumbles, that allows an extra running
low full toss and he pushes it back to the off side
exposes his stumps but manages to tap it back to the bowler

Kallis doesn't look very thrilled as he trudges back, the ball holds its line outside off and kallis shapes to play an off drive, there's a thin nick and both the bowler and keeper are confident, Kallis didn't look back, the stump cam picked up a nick
cramps him up for room and he defends softly
just as good and for precision Kallis gets full marks, he rolls his wrists to a wide delivery and cracks it past backward point and cover point, both dived and watched the ball disappear
man you should have heard the sound of that! Short and wide outside off, Kallis bends backwards just a touch to give himself that extra thrust and power and he cracks it high over backward point
holds the length back and he taps it to the off side
class! This guy is good, he bends his knee to a full-pitched away swinger and plays the most elegant of square drives, one for the album
and Pandey's in business straightaway, he follows the late away swing and pushes it through the line and beats short cover, Badri gives the chase but the ball accelerates
reaches out to drive straight but he gets an inside edge which drops in front of short mid-on
reaches out and pats it back to the bowler, checked his shot
gets a nice angle outside off, late movement and Kallis shoulders arms, yes this is a T20 match
